接口 MethodHandleTransformer

所有已知实现类:
DefaultInternalObjectFilter
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface MethodHandleTransformer
A generic interface describing operations that transform method handles. Typical usage is for implementing internal objects filters.
